headline_item.title_zh: 苹果关停运营近30年的官方支持论坛
headline_item.title_en: Apple says its Apple Support Community forum will close permanently on November 20 and starting today the site is read-only and no longer accepts new posts (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 苹果官方支持社区即日起关闭发帖功能，并将于11月20日彻底关停，标志着该讨论平台正式退出历史舞台
headline_item.event_summary_en: only state, and users are now directed to the official Apple Support webpage for assistance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】苹果公司：永久关闭论坛，即日起只读、禁止发帖
【起因与机理】优化服务渠道，将用户流量导向官方支持中心
【关键技术规格】论坛从1998年运营至今。
【观点态度】11月20日将彻底关闭，导向官方支持系统。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Apple (Apple Support Community portal): Shutting down the forum permanently, read-only mode effective immediately
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Consolidating support channels and migrating traffic to the official support hub
[Perspective & Impact] Permanent shutdown on Nov 20, migrating to official support.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 一个自乔布斯时代就在的社区被强行“清理掉”，这不仅是服务器空间的节省，更是苹果对“用户互助”这类不可控变量的彻底摒弃。毕竟，官方支持页面才是一言堂，哪能容得下你们在论坛里吐槽产品质量。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Killing off a community forum that’s existed since the Jobs era isn't just about saving server costs—it’s about sanitizing the narrative. Apple would clearly rather you hit their polished, controlled support page than let you vent and compare notes on defects in a public forum.

headlines.title_zh: 黄仁勋卷入间谍丑闻，英伟达芯片出口恐遭国会严限
headlines.title_en: Sources: Jensen Huang's affair has significantly raised the chances of Congress enacting chip export limits this year via the National Defense Authorization Act (Politico)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 因深陷间谍丑闻引发国家安全担忧，英伟达CEO黄仁勋正促使美国国会加速通过国防授权法案以限制高端芯片出口
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's involvement in a recent espionage scandal has heightened national security concerns within Congress. Consequently, lawmakers are accelerating the National Defense Authorization Act to impose stricter export controls on high-end AI chips this year, effectively turning Nvidia from a tech champion into a high-risk liability.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达CEO黄仁勋及美国国会在美国国会山立法进程：因间谍丑闻发酵，国会正加快通过《国防授权法案》以限制芯片出口
【起因与机理】针对英伟达在关键AI硬件领域的垄断地位及国家安全风险进行的监管博弈
【关键技术规格】国会利用《国防授权法案》施压出口限制。
【观点态度】AI芯片供应链面临更严苛的政治审查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang and the US Congress (Capitol Hill legislative process): Accelerating the NDAA to restrict chip exports amid espionage allegations
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Escalating national security concerns regarding Nvidia's dominance in AI hardware
[Key Specification] Jensen Huang caught in espionage scandal.
[Perspective & Impact] AI chip supply chain facing harsher political scrutiny.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 原本还在靠AI叙事割资本市场韭菜，这下直接把自己割到了国家安全红线上。所谓“技术无国界”的公关辞令，在间谍指控面前脆弱得像一张废纸，黄教主这回是真的要把英伟达“送”进国会山的严刑拷打室了。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Nvidia went from riding the AI hype wave to hitting the national security tripwire in record time. So much for 'technology having no borders'; when espionage allegations enter the chat, even a trillion-dollar market cap looks like a giant target for congressional target practice.

headlines.title_zh: 黄仁勋卷入间谍绯闻，英伟达市值震荡
headlines.title_en: Nvidia's stock fell 5.47% on Tuesday, following a 4%+ drop on Monday after the revelation of Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy (April Roach/CNBC)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 黄仁勋承认婚外情，且对象被指为中国情报人员，英伟达股价连续两日大跌并一度失守4万亿市值
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with an executive from client Megaspeed, who has subsequently been identified by U.S. officials as a Chinese intelligence asset allegedly funneling AI chip technology. The geopolitical and ethical fallout sent Nvidia's stock into a two-day slide, briefly dipping below $4 trillion in market cap as the FBI launched an investigation.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达CEO黄仁勋、Alice Huang（Megaspeed高管）在英伟达内部邮件、美白宫及金融市场：承认婚外情并接受联邦调查，公司市值大幅缩水
【起因与机理】涉事对象被指控为中国情报人员，引发芯片技术安全与地缘博弈忧虑
【关键数据与实测】股价受丑闻影响两日大跌，市值一度跌破4万亿。
【观点态度】美国FBI介入调查涉及的芯片违规输送问题。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang, Alice Huang: Admission of affair, FBI investigation, stock price decline
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Security concerns over sensitive AI chip technology and foreign intelligence ties
[Key Metrics] Stock plunges, briefly losing $4T market cap.
[Perspective & Impact] FBI investigation into potential chip leakage.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这哪里是中年危机，这分明是好莱坞版的《芯片谍影》。老黄原本是靠皮衣撑起AI信仰的男人，结果最后败给了“美人计”，这届硅谷精英在诱惑面前的防线，简直比防范量子计算破解还要脆弱。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This isn't a mid-life crisis; it's a Hollywood-grade espionage thriller. Jensen went from the high-priest of AI in a leather jacket to a security liability, proving once again that Silicon Valley's defense against human instinct is far more vulnerable than its defense against quantum computing.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
